title: The Prison Meditation Class
why_movie: A real first-person Kevin story with a place (the prison), people (the inmates and the officers) and a turn: half the population showed up to meditate and the disciplinary reports collapsed, ending on an officer's own question.

scenes.gen: A plain prison classroom, rows of men in grey jumpsuits sitting cross-legged on a bare floor, a guard watching from the doorway, cinderblock walls, flat fluorescent light
scenes.move: the men settle into stillness one by one as the guard crosses his arms in the doorway

scenes.on: about half of the inmate population went
scenes.gen: The same prison classroom now crowded, more than half the cell block's men in grey jumpsuits packed onto the floor and along the walls, a guard counting heads from the door
scenes.move: more men file in through the door and sit down as the guard's eyebrows rise while counting

scenes.on: incident reports to inmates who break the rules
scenes.gen: Close view of a prison officer's desk, a stack of carbon-copy disciplinary report forms under a gooseneck lamp, a pen resting on top, a barred window behind showing the cell block
scenes.move: the officer's pen taps the blank top form once, then sets down untouched

scenes.on: It's an incident report or a disciplinary action
scenes.gen: The same officer's desk, the stack of disciplinary report forms now gathering a thin layer of dust, a wall calendar nearby with many days crossed off in a row
scenes.move: the officer glances at the dusty, untouched stack and slowly shakes his head

scenes.on: the number of disciplinary actions went down
scenes.gen: Inside the prison classroom, a long row of grey-jumpsuited men sitting cross-legged with eyes closed in meditation, calm and still, pale morning light through a high barred window
scenes.move: the men breathe slowly in unison while a guard at the back slowly lowers his folded arms

scenes.on: The energy in the inmate population radically changed
scenes.gen: A wide shot of a prison yard, men in grey jumpsuits walking calmly in loose lines instead of clustering in tense groups, a guard tower in the background under pale daylight
scenes.move: two men who once stood apart now walk side by side, calm, past the guard tower

scenes.on: what type of hypnotic spell did you put on everybody
scenes.gen: A prison officer standing in a corridor doorway, arms spread wide in disbelief, looking back over his shoulder at the meditation classroom behind him under fluorescent light
scenes.move: the officer spreads his hands and shakes his head slowly, looking back over his shoulder in disbelief

payoff: what type of hypnotic spell did you put on everybody
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says that while he was in prison, he taught a meditation class - and more than half the inmate population showed up, which surprised everyone running the place.

Soon the officers' own disciplinary reports, the ones inmates call "a shot," nearly stopped altogether. The whole energy of the population changed.

One officer finally pulled him aside with a question nobody expected.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching how to use your mind to change your life from the inside out, the same way he says he changed a prison block.

Most people will scroll past this. A few will comment "WISH" and start tonight.
